summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for Data Flow & Rules Manager super-admin scope, rule update/audit trail, non-super-admin restriction, and build gates.
action_items: No blocking functional fixes required for requested Data Flow & Rules Manager scope.
If auth playbook target changed to 5 failed attempts lockout, align backend constants and docs (current behavior: lock on 4th attempt after 3 failures).
If strict CORS verification is required, validate against internal service origin as public ingress/cloudflare may override preflight headers.
critical_code_review_comments: Requested scope is passing end-to-end on public URL with correct super-admin-only enforcement and audit before/after snapshots.
Backend server.py remains monolithic (>700 lines); split into modules to reduce regression risk.
Optional auth playbook mismatch persists: requested brute-force lockout after 5 failures vs implemented project policy lockout after 3 failures.
seed_data_creation: Updated one accounting rule notes field with TEST_ITER61 marker and restored original value immediately in-test (non-destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on public URL: GET /api/admin/data-flow-rules-manager returns flow_monitor + rules + validation_tests with required fields; PUT /api/admin/data-flow-rules-manager/rules/{id}?organization_id=social-solidarity updates only accounting_rules (journal entries count unchanged), then restored original; audit logs include before_document and after_document for rule update path; super admin UI shows Data Flow & Rules Manager with Flow Monitor + Rules Engine + Validation and rule actions; normal admin cannot see manager section and gets 403 on manager endpoint; yarn lint and yarn craco build passed; /app/dist/BankDepositSystemSetup.exe exists.
rca of the issue: No requested-scope blocker found. Prior transient UI failure was test-timing related (manager data not refreshed before asserting dynamic action buttons), mitigated by explicit refresh/wait in Playwright flow.
